observations.observation: Casbin documents configurable RBAC and role hierarchies, including domains for tenant-scoped roles.
observations.freshnessScope: Official Casbin model documentation at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: The evidence does not establish Node.js 24 compatibility or the repository-specific persistence and synchronization design.

observations.observation: CASL documents support for Node.js 18 and later, declarative subject and attribute rules, and an official Prisma integration for filtering database records.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository ecosystem table and authorization model at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: The source does not claim a persistent Zanzibar-style relationship graph.

observations.observation: Cerbos is a self-hostable policy decision point for context-aware resource policies and exposes language-agnostic APIs.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository capabilities and deployment model at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: The observation does not establish a native persisted relationship tuple model.

observations.observation: OpenFGA is a Zanzibar-inspired fine-grained authorization server for relationship-based access and supports PostgreSQL persistence plus HTTP and gRPC APIs.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository README and storage documentation at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Operational sizing and migration cost for this synthetic repository remain unmeasured.
